clips.title: The story
paras: Witch Doctor Uzer'i is a jungle troll mystic residing at Camp Mojache in the primordial forests of Feralas. Dedicated to advancing the magical capabilities of the Horde, he researches techniques to trap and harness the muisek—the spiritual essence of powerful natural creatures. By capturing these ancient forest spirits, Uzer'i seeks to channel the raw primal energies traditionally favored by night elves directly into enchanted weapons.

Rooted in traditional troll spiritualism, Witch Doctor Uzer'i has spent considerable effort studying the natural magic inherent to the untamed wilderness of Feralas. He argues that night elves have drawn upon the spirits of forest beasts for millennia, and believes the time has come for the Horde to seize those same primal forces. Central to his study is the concept of muisek: the vibrant spiritual essence that remains within a creature. To harness it, Uzer'i crafts specialized vessels capable of rapidly shrinking fallen beings before their escaping spirit disperses, allowing the essence to be stored and studied.

Extracting muisek was merely the first phase of Uzer'i's broader ambition. Gathering resilient sinew, enchanted minerals, and petrified splintered logs from the very creatures whose spirits he trapped, the witch doctor fused physical materials with bound muisek. Through these rites, he learned to permanently bind ancient forest spirits into arms and armaments, providing the Horde with magically charged weapons. Beyond his ritual craftsmanship, Uzer'i maintains a deep curiosity regarding hidden places of power throughout Azeroth, actively tracking rumors of the ancient, submerged Sunken Temple.
